richiami.difetto: The clip-on handlebar is susceptible to Stress Corrosion Cracking. This can cause the part to fail during use and could affect control of the machine. The manufacturer recommends to immediately STOP using the clip-ons
richiami.modello: CLIP ON HANDLEBARS , CLIP ON HANDLEBARS
richiami.rimedio: Replace affected components with an alternative version with a superior resistance  to Stress Corrosion Cracking.
